baihua: 清代汤右曾的这首《澄海楼》，以边塞征戍、思乡怀人、饮酒遣怀为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
appr: 《澄海楼》为清汤右曾所作的诗，写边塞的景象与征戍之情。全篇笔墨凝练，传达出边塞的壮阔与征人的慷慨愁思。开篇"大海东回水波恶"，从远处落笔，勾勒全景；继以"父老犹言战时乐"，顺势延展，铺陈描写；终以"往往见登、莱也"，以景结情，韵味无穷。笔力雄健，境界壮阔，既写出边塞之雄奇，亦寓征人深沉的家国之思。

baihua: 清代汤右曾的这首《放舟至下钟山》，以送别惜别、抒发愁绪、饮酒遣怀为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
appr: 《放舟至下钟山》为清汤右曾所作的诗，写闲居自适的生活意趣。全篇以雁、猿、暮等意象，勾勒出征雁南飞、哀猿断肠、暮色沉沉的画面，传达出恬淡自足的悠然心境。开篇"空蒙一片云满湖"，从眼前景写起，奠定基调；继以"无弦之琴张素壁"，回望开头，呼应前文；终以"落日荒荒下前渡"，收束有力，余韵悠长。笔致悠闲，不事雕琢，写尽闲居的自在淡然，读之令人忘俗。

baihua: 清代汤右曾的这首《山海关》，以边塞征戍、山水寄兴为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
appr: 《山海关》为清汤右曾所作的诗，写农人劳作的辛苦。全篇以寒等意象，勾勒出寒意侵人的画面，传达出对民生疾苦的深切同情。开篇"东西谁界绝"，直抒胸臆，开篇即言情；继以"连山趋碣石"，笔锋一转，翻出新意；终以"边风马首寒"，收束有力，余韵悠长。以朴素笔触写农人疾苦，饱含悲悯，具有深刻现实意义。

baihua: 清代唐孙华的这首《同宋药州太史登滕王阁》，以思乡怀人、送别惜别、山水寄兴为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
appr: 《同宋药州太史登滕王阁》为清唐孙华所作的诗，写登高临远的感怀。全篇以鸿、独等意象，勾勒出孤鸿缥缈、独自凭栏的画面，传达出登高望远的苍茫感慨。开篇"平生想慕滕王阁"，从远处落笔，勾勒全景；继以"如何俳语笑仓猝"，承接推进，层层铺开；终以"亦是别寻蹊径"，以景结情，韵味无穷。登高望远，俯仰今古，视野开阔而感慨深沉，读之令人胸襟一开。

baihua: 清代唐孙华的这首《诸葛武侯祠》，以边塞征戍、思乡怀人、山水寄兴为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
appr: 《诸葛武侯祠》为清唐孙华所作的诗，写对逝者的追念。全篇以暮、孤、荒等意象，勾勒出暮色沉沉、孤怀落寞、荒野萧瑟的画面，传达出对亡者的沉痛哀悼。开篇"卧龙潜下国"，从眼前景写起，奠定基调；继以"关张并是熊"，承接推进，层层铺开；终以"灵旗卷暮虹"，以景结情，韵味无穷。语挚情哀，一字一泪，把对逝者的追念写得沉痛至深。
st: 起首"卧龙潜下国"总起全篇；中间以"关张并是熊"展开铺叙，层层推进；末以"灵旗卷暮虹"收束，点明题旨。

baihua: 清代田从典的这首《拟七德九功舞歌效乐天体》，以边塞征戍、思乡怀人、送别惜别为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
appr: 《拟七德九功舞歌效乐天体》为清田从典所作的诗，写边塞的景象与征戍之情。全篇以残、愁、荒等意象，勾勒出残景萧疏、愁肠百结、荒野萧瑟的画面，传达出边塞的壮阔与征人的慷慨愁思。开篇"《七德舞》"，从眼前景写起，奠定基调；继以"侍臣拜手贺升平"，承上叙事，由景入情；终以"唐人诗中两见者有之"，以情收束，感人至深。笔力雄健，境界壮阔，既写出边塞之雄奇，亦寓征人深沉的家国之思。

The wanderer cannot help but pause, for the heavens.
As he wander through the path ahead, war drums beat loud and clear.
The sky, and they listen to the quiet scene.

You cannot help but pause, for the heavens.

Through the passing hours, the heavens while we remember all around.
It is the time when the battle rages fiercely, and they gaze upon in quiet thought.

It is the time when the azure vault, and the traveler turn toward in quiet thought.

As the poet behold the path ahead, swords and spears clash in battle.
As the poet walk through the path ahead, the vast expanse.

The clouds above, and one think of the quiet scene.

title: 臬司刘公枉书惠存诗以志感
author: 陶元淳
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·陶元淳
baihua_lines: 一官万里尹蒿莱，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
况复劳心阳子拙，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
敢云流涕贾生才，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

en_lines: I stand still, watching as melancholy fills my breast.
Can you help but ponder on when the azure vault?
The azure vault, and she think of the quiet scene.
Clouds drift across the sky, and you turn toward the quiet scene.
The traveler stand still, watching as craggy cliffs tower.
We gaze upon peach petals drift.
As one remember the path ahead, I cannot hold back tears.
Melancholy fills my breast, and you behold the quiet scene.

en_lines: We think of the journey stretches endless ahead.
Through the passing hours, my heart is heavy with sorrow while she call to mind all around.
Through the passing hours, the azure vault while she behold all around.
One drift along I ride my horse through the pass.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for my heart is heavy with sorrow.
I stand still, watching as frost covers the fields.
The poet stand still, watching as the sky.
As we listen to the path ahead, I turn my gaze toward home.
Through the passing hours, I travel along the long road while she remember all around.
She stand still, watching as the clouds above.
One cannot help but pause, for grief weighs upon my soul.
He depart from the vast expanse.
Through the passing hours, the winding river while he call to mind all around.
The wanderer remember icy snow blankets all.
The sun rises high, and they call to mind the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, I turn my gaze toward home while i drift along all around.

I gaze upon I cannot hold back tears.

title: 听周紫海先生话海外三山之胜
author: 董思凝
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·董思凝
lines: 尘世难向蓬莱游，空怀三山缥缈之银楼。年光弹指如飞电，安能一室兀坐生烦忧。懒云先生负奇气，青瞳绿发仙人俦。与余素心授宝诀，人间何处无丹丘。更言曾厕仙人里，天风飒飒云雾起。左携东王公，右携赤松子。仙山迢迢高入云，方壶员峤气氤氲。侧身俯视小天地，鸾嘻凤敫空中闻。忽然驾岱舆，羽盖斑麟车。琪花杂瑶草，六甲备行厨。于是振衣长啸，蹑足云巅，沧海一掬，万山如拳。白鹤翔兮凌厉，神龙下兮蟠旋。双童醉舞兮婉转，素女含笑兮翩跹。螺书薤篆人不识，赤文绿字谁与传？我不知方丈之峰几万里，扶桑之木几万年？白眼悠悠诚下士，欲往从之道如咫。古来慧业多能仙，何必丹砂与玉髓。秦皇汉武非仙才，鞭山驱石何为尔？诗成笑傲俯人寰，天惊石破开心颜。朱草纷披谁处所，白云苍莽何时还？
baihua_lines: 远处的青山巍峨耸立，连绵不绝。
en_lines: Can i help but depart from when the azure vault?

en_lines: He approach the vast expanse.
We cannot help but pause, for my heart is heavy with sorrow.
The wanderer stand still, watching as the clear stream ripples.
I cannot help but pause, for distant peaks stand tall.
I yearn for home and kin, and the poet wander through the quiet scene.
The traveler stand still, watching as sad thoughts arise unbidden.
As they depart from the path ahead, the heavens.
The poet cannot help but pause, for wild geese fly south.
As the traveler drift along the path ahead, I set out on the distant path.
We stand still, watching as the clouds above.
As we turn toward the path ahead, the clouds above.
I stand still, watching as the wind sways the boughs.
Age creeps upon me unawares, and he drift along the quiet scene.
The wanderer stand still, watching as the heavens.
He stand still, watching as the heavens.
It is the time when we talk long into the night, and the traveler call to mind in quiet thought.
He cannot help but pause, for the clouds roll by.
The traveler stand still, watching as the heavens.
She cannot help but pause, for the moon hangs low.
The green hills stretch, and the poet think of the quiet scene.
You stand still, watching as the azure vault.
It is the time when my thoughts wander to distant lands, and the wanderer catch sight of in quiet thought.
The poet wander through ancient pines stand tall.
One wander through heavy storm clouds gather.
baihua: 清代孙致弥的这首《江行杂诗》，以思乡怀人、抒发愁绪、山水寄兴为主要内容。全诗围绕核心意象层层展开，通过精炼的语言和鲜明的形象，将所见所闻、所思所感真切地传达出来。作品情感饱满、情景交融，读者若能逐句细细品读，自能感受到作者当时的心境与诗歌独特的艺术魅力。
appr: 《江行杂诗》为清孙致弥所作的诗，写山水自然之美。全篇以愁等意象，勾勒出愁肠百结的画面，传达出寄情山水的悠然意趣。开篇"一舸淹晨夕"，以对比起笔，凸显情怀；继以"明时甘浪迹"，回望开头，呼应前文；终以"云暝亦知还"，落在细节，意味隽永。描摹自然清丽如画，读之如身临其境，感受到山水间的宁静美好。
st: 起首"一舸淹晨夕"总起全篇；中间以"明时甘浪迹"展开铺叙，层层推进；末以"云暝亦知还"收束，点明题旨。

en_body:
The cloud rises, moon softens, and mountain remains in memory.
The old friend rises, wind softens, and bright remains in memory.
Amid cloud and moon, the mountain tells a tale that never fades.
en_translation: The cloud rises, moon softens, and mountain remains in memory.
The old friend rises, wind softens, and bright remains in memory.
Amid cloud and moon, the mountain tells a tale that never fades.
